commit.subject: LU-18357 tests: skip sanity-sec/27a in interop
commit.message:
LU-18357 tests: skip sanity-sec/27a in interop

Skip sanity-sec.sh test_27a when running interop tests with old
clients.  The format of the fileset output was changed when it
gained support for multiple fileset export.
